title: Cerebus Mothers & Daughters #154 Jan 1992 - Aardvark-Vanaheim
descriptionText:
Cerebus the Aardvark continues its epic saga with "Mothers & Daughters Issue #4," dated January 1992, as issue number 154 in the series. Published by Aardvark-Vanaheim, this comic book represents a unique blend of storytelling and artwork that has captivated readers since the character's inception.

Set during the Modern Age of comics, this piece is a must-have for enthusiasts of the genre and collectors alike. Dive into the complex narrative and vibrant illustrations that have become synonymous with the Cerebus series, and add this iconic US comic book to your collection today.
